name: JAKA K1
dof_breakdown: 29 movable joints; 7-DOF per arm, 14 per arm assembly
summary: A dual-arm industrial humanoid from a collaborative-arm maker: no legs, but a human-scale upper body with 7-DOF arms under synchronized control so the two can work in the same space without colliding. Six-dimensional force control and depth cameras aim it at electronics assembly and other work where excess force ruins the part.
notable: Synchronized dual-arm control with six-dimensional force sensing

sources.title: JAKA K1 humanoid dual-arm robot — Applicad
JAKA K-1 robot debuts with high range of motion and dexterity
